# Vihakids

> Vihakids offers live, online, one-on-one and small-batch tuitions in English, Hindi, Mathematics, Science and Kannada for school students in 1st to 10th Standard, covering CBSE, ICSE and State Board syllabus. Headquartered in Bengaluru, India, and serving students across India and abroad.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://www.vihakids.com/): Overview, subjects, programs and free demo registration.
- [Register](https://www.vihakids.com/register): Sign up for a free demo class.
- [Teach with us](https://www.vihakids.com/teach): Apply to become a Vihakids tutor.
- [About Us](https://www.vihakids.com/about.html): Who Vihakids is and how classes work.
- [Blog](https://www.vihakids.com/blog.html): Articles on tuitions, boards and learning tips.
- [Parent FAQ](https://www.vihakids.com/faq): Answers to the questions parents ask before choosing online tuition — class format, tutors, timings, fees, refunds, progress updates and safety.
- [Fees](https://www.vihakids.com/fees): Monthly fee per subject by grade band.

## Free printable worksheets

- [Kannada Varnamale tracing worksheet](https://www.vihakids.com/kannada-alphabet-tracing-worksheet): All 15 Kannada vowels and 34 consonants to trace and copy.
- [Hindi Varnamala tracing worksheet](https://www.vihakids.com/hindi-varnamala-tracing-worksheet): All 13 Hindi vowels, 33 consonants and the joined letters क्ष, त्र, ज्ञ, श्र.
- [English alphabet tracing worksheet](https://www.vihakids.com/english-alphabet-tracing-worksheet): A to Z capital and small letters with a picture word for each.
